_doc: Thresholds for the public-funnel Lighthouse / Playwright audit. Required = audit fails the build if the score is below the threshold. Warning = audit logs a warning but does not fail the build (we are not regression-gating perf yet because tooling availability is not guaranteed across machines).

fallback_playwright._doc: When the Lighthouse CLI is not available we fall back to a structural Playwright audit. All structural rules are required: we expect the public funnels to never regress on these.
